email.subject: Thank you for applying to Chronograph
email.body:
Candidate,

Thank you for your interest in joining Chronograph!

We have received your application. Once our team has a chance to review your information, we'll reach out if your experience and profile is a fit for the role.

If we don't move forward with your application for this position, we'll be sure to keep you in mind for future openings as our team continues to grow.

All the best,

Chronograph Recruiting

recorded.raw: {"status": "Applied", "row": 314, "confidence": "high", "reason": "The email says \"We have received your application\" and only hypothetically mentions \"if we don't move forward with your application\", so it confirms receipt rather than a decision."}
